source: oracles/uapki/library/uapkic/src/dstu7624.c dstu7624_ctr_self_test (case 1) and oracles/bouncycastle-java DSTU7624Test.java's BlockCipherVectorTest #25 (case 2, KCTRBlockCipher) - only Kalyna128_128 has any CTR vector in either vendored oracle; other variants are unverified against an external oracle for CTR specifically, relying instead on this mode's shared keystream logic with the already dual-oracle-verified hazmat::kalyna_ccm (both call the same dstu7624.c encrypt_ctr internally) plus the proptest chunk-invariance suite. BC test #24 is byte-for-byte identical to case 1 here (same dual-lineage relationship already established for CCM/GCM/KW), not an independent third vector. Case 3 added by T-234: DSTU 7624:2014 (draft edition), annex В.3.2 (decryption example, N=20 bits -> 2 bytes). Values programmatically extracted from the annex text (not hand-transcribed). Where the annex's bit length N is not a multiple of 8, only the leading floor(N/8) whole bytes are kept (annex В.1: the last byte's (N mod 8) most significant bits carry the tail) - valid for a stream mode, since each output byte depends only on the keystream and its own input byte. Note (T-234): case 1 is itself annex В.3.1 - the uapki KAT and the annex are the same source.
